title: Strawberry Spinach Smoothie
subtitle: Green · Green
description: Strawberry-banana sweetness hides the spinach completely. A good first step when the hall wants to eat better without a lecture.
intro: Strawberry-banana sweetness hides the spinach completely. A good first step when the hall wants to eat better without a lecture.

steps.title: Gather ingredients and equipment
steps.instruction: Line up every ingredient for Strawberry Spinach Smoothie in the order you will cook — measure spices into ramekins, trim proteins on a dedicated board, and set tongs, thermometers, and hotel pans within arm's reach before any heat goes on.

steps.title: Preheat ovens and surfaces
steps.instruction: Preheat ovens, griddles, or grills to recipe temp before the crew arrives — cold equipment extends cook time and dries out batch Blend. Confirm burners ignite evenly and sheet pans are greased or lined.

steps.title: Blend spinach with milk
steps.instruction: Blend spinach with milk first until smooth — no visible leaves. Serve cold within 10 minutes — hold blended cups on ice at 38°F if the line runs long. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Add strawberries, banana, and
steps.instruction: Add strawberries, banana, and yogurt. Blend until thick and pink, not brown. Serve cold within 10 minutes — hold blended cups on ice at 38°F if the line runs long. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Stir in chia at
steps.instruction: Stir in chia at the end if using, or blend 10 seconds on low. Serve cold within 10 minutes — hold blended cups on ice at 38°F if the line runs long. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

steps.title: Drink within a few
steps.instruction: Drink within a few hours; chia will thicken if it sits overnight. Serve cold within 10 minutes — hold blended cups on ice at 38°F if the line runs long. Work in batches if the pan or grill crowding steams food instead of browning — rookies should watch for pale surfaces and adjust heat early.

nutrition.highlights: ~250 cal · ~16 g protein · fiber from fruit and optional chia · greens without salad fatigue
nutrition.label: per serving (hall portion)

substitutions: Flax meal (1 tbsp) instead of chia.
shiftNote: Easy sell to crews skeptical of green food — looks and tastes like a berry shake.
proTips: Easy sell to crews skeptical of green food — looks and tastes like a berry shake.
Rinse the blender jar between batches so flavors do not muddy the next crew's cups.
If tones drop during service, cover hot food and hold at 140°F — note hold time on the pan for food safety.
tonightSpread: Pour Strawberry Spinach Smoothie into insulated cups or quart jars on ice for grab-and-go service.
Set granola, nut butter, and extra fruit in side bowls so crew can customize without slowing the line.
Keep a backup blender batch chilled at 38°F if service runs past 20 minutes.
leftovers: Cool leftovers in shallow containers within two hours — deep pots stay hot too long.
Label trays with date and reheat to 165°F minimum before second shift.
